purpose: Transparent selection paint only; original artwork is not included.

sources.role: Original 28px check vector, unchanged paths and colors
Original black paint and intended 30% opacity

assets.transform: Only combine full-size uniform black selection mask with the original centered check vector, then rasterize at 2×. No thumbnail or component pixels are included.
assets.alphaQuantization: 30% black uses the same 77/255 quantization as selection-mask.png; previous 1px mask encoded 76/255.
